Adjective and its Types
An adjective modifies a | Noun | Verb | Adverb | Preposition | A | Adjective
Classify "friendly" based on its part of speech. | Adjective | Noun | Verb | Adverb | A | Adjective
In the sentence "My bag is under the kitchen table", what is the underlined word's part of speech? | Noun | Verb | Adjective | Adverb | C | Attributive Adjective
Better to be untaught than (ill-taught). ill taught is: | Adjective | Noun | Verb | None of these | A | Attributive Adjective
"I think the later part of the movie was interesting." The word "later" is | Adverb | Adjective | Verb | None of these | B | Attributive Adjective
The metal plate is hard. Hard is which part of speech? | Adverb | Adjective | Noun | None of these | B | Predicative Adjective
There was much effort for little work. Identify the parts of speech word : much | Quantitative adjective | Qualitative adjective | Subjective adjective | None of these | A | Quantitative adjective
The hand has five fingers. In this sentence five is: | Noun | Adverb | Adjective | None of these | C | Quantitative adjective
Fill in the blank with suitable words: ____ people have ____ knowledge of physics. | Very few, some | A few, some | Few, Little | A few, very little | B | Qualitative adjective
He gave me ____ quantity of milk. | A small | small | A little | None of these | C | Qualitative adjective
Bring me ____ water. | Some | Little | A little | None of these | A | Qualitative adjective
The doctor recommended ____ tablets and asked to drink ____ of water. | -/a lot | -/lot | Some/plenty | None of these | C | Qualitative adjective
Choose the correct words from the options to complete the sentence correctly: Khalid is ____ Naveed | Not as tall | As tall | As if not | As tall as | D | Comparative adjective (as/as degree)
Which of the following is a comparative degree? | Angry | Taller | Bad | Worst | B | Comparative adjective
Ali is my best friend. Best is which part of speech? | Noun | Verb | Adjective | Adverb | C | Superlative adjective
____ dangerously a person lives ____ chances of his death in young age. | The more/the more | the most/the more | the most/the most | None of these | A | Degree of Adjective
Choose the correct sentence | The higher you go, the cooler it gets | The higher you go, the cooler it is | The high you go, the cooler it is | The high you go, the coolest it is: | D | Comparative adjective
Choose the correct sentence: This cloth is more superior than that. | This cloth is more superior than that. | This cloth is superior than that. | This cloth is more superior to that. | This cloth is superior to that. | D | Degree of Adjective
Choose one correct sentence: She is more prettier than her sister. | She is prettier than her sister | She is most prettier than her sister | She has prettier than her sister | None of these | A | Comparative adjective
Choose the correct one: | This is a perfect example | This is a most perfect example | This is most perfect example | None of these | A | Degree of Adjective
The students in our school are ____ in other schools | Smarter | smarter than | smarter than those | smarter than | C | Comparative adjective
This is ____ of all trees: | more shortest | shortest | most shortest | None of these | B | Superlative adjective
Correct sentence: "This is the elder tree in the forest". | Old | elder | Oldest | None of these | C | Superlative adjective
He is the ____ in the class. | Best | Top | Prime | Leading | A | Superlative adjective
She is older ____ Amina but ____ oldest of the all. | than/the | an/a | than/a | a/the | A | Degree of Adjective

Article and its Types
____ Turkish delegation including two persons ____ visiting Pakistan. | the/is | a/is | the/are | None of these | B | article a/is
Yesterday, I met ____ European | A | An | The | None of these | A | Indefinite Article
Choose the suitable word to fill in the blanks: I met ____ European? | A | The | Some | An | A | Indefinite Article
She bought ____ more expensive car than i do | an | a | No article is used | the | B | Indefinite Article
____ baby likes ____ funny story. | a/a | The/a | -/- | An/a | A | Indefinite Article
He is ____ M.A English. | A | An | At | None of these | B | Indefinite Article
When she goes outside she takes ____ Umbrella? | An | A | Of | None of these | A | Indefinite Article
